home.whatBody: Dictation Notes is a personal meeting notebook and reply cue. While you stay in the room, the other person’s words become text, and you can ask for a short line you can actually say. You bring your own speech and AI keys. We do not run a backend, and we do not ship developer keys.
home.notBody: On iPhone, leaving the app or locking the phone stops dictation. On Mac, use the window, menu bar or Option-Shift-D to start and stop capture; quitting stops capture. Obtain any required participant consent before recording or transcribing.
home.useMeetB: Talk and watch the transcript at the same time. History and recordings stay on this device by default.
home.useTalkB: Set a goal, background, and speaking style for this session, then ask for a reply, a summary, a critique, or a short forecast.
home.useLangB: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, and Indonesian.
home.localBody: Free dictation needs no API key. Apple speech recognition may process audio on the device or send it to Apple when local recognition is unavailable. Cloud transcription and AI send data directly to the provider you select and authorize. We do not run a backend receiving your recordings or transcripts.
home.byokBody: The app ships with no developer API keys and does not proxy requests. Whoever you pick sends the bill. You can also point it at your own compatible chat completions endpoint.
home.howLead: Listen, ask, then keep the record on the device. Cloud and AI uses share one trial counter.
home.howListenB: Allow the microphone. On-device dictation needs no key. Add a speech provider you trust only if you want cloud transcription.
home.howAskB: Request a reply, a summary, a critique, an explanation, or a short forecast. Those requests go to the AI provider you configured.
home.howKeepB: History and recordings stay on the device unless you export or share them. We have nowhere to receive them.

privacy.p1: Dictation Notes (听写笔记) provides transcription and AI help on Mac and iPhone. We do not operate an application content backend. Apple and your selected providers may process data; support emails are handled as described below.
privacy.pWho: The app is published on the App Store by Shanghai Qishan Cultural Communication Co., Ltd. Copyright is marked © 2026 Zhichao Wei. Privacy questions: 281916057@qq.com.
privacy.pCollect: There is no developer server receiving accounts, analytics events, advertising IDs, or crash dossiers. The app does not embed a tracking SDK and does not track across apps.
privacy.pLocal: API keys use the system Keychain on iPhone and Mac. Recordings, transcripts, session history and settings are stored on the device; there is no developer content server or automatic history synchronization. Exports go to the destination you choose. Clear history and keys in the app before uninstalling if you want to remove them.
privacy.pProviders: After your permission, cloud transcription sends audio to your chosen speech provider. AI replies, translation and summaries send transcripts, questions, conversation history and any background you enter to your chosen AI provider. On Mac, permission identifies the provider and endpoint; changing the recipient requires new permission. Each provider determines its own processing, retention and international transfers. A model running on this Mac receives text locally.
privacy.pRecord: Recordings and transcripts may contain sensitive conversation. Use recording, transcription, or summaries only where legal and with any required consent. The app repeats this notice before the first listening session.
privacy.pPurchase: The lifetime unlock is processed by Apple through the App Store. We do not receive or store payment card information. Apple may process purchase receipts under its own privacy policy. This is a non-consumable one-time purchase, not an auto-renewing subscription.
privacy.pStore: The App Store label includes optional cloud-provider collection of audio, other user content, user IDs, usage, diagnostic and network data. Data may be linked to your provider account. The developer does not receive audio, transcripts, AI prompts or payment card details.
privacy.pSite: This static site is hosted on GitHub Pages. We use no analytics, advertising, tracking SDKs or language-preference storage. Fonts and screenshots are served with the site. GitHub may process IP addresses and ordinary access logs under its privacy policy. Visiting App Store or provider links is subject to the destination's policy.
privacy.pRights: You can delete sessions, recordings and keys in the app. On Mac, Settings also lets you revoke data sharing permission and stop current requests. Deleting the Mac app alone may leave local data; clear history and keys in the app before uninstalling. Copies you exported or shared must be deleted at their destination.
privacy.pChildren: The app is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy.pChange: If this policy changes in a material way, we will update the date and publish the revision here. Continued use means you have seen the updated notice.
privacy.pContact: For privacy questions write to 281916057@qq.com and include device, OS version, and app version. Do not paste API keys or raw recordings in email.

support.startBody: Install from the App Store, allow the microphone and speech recognition, then tap Start. On-device dictation stays free and does not count toward the trial. Add your own key in Settings later if you want cloud transcription or AI replies, then save and test.
support.a1: Allow the microphone first. On-device dictation also needs speech recognition permission. Turn both on in system Settings, then tap Start again. Some languages may use Apple speech recognition if an offline model is missing, and that path needs a network.
support.q2: How to connect your own API
support.a2: Open Settings, pick an AI or transcription provider, paste the key, then save and test. Common providers do not need a custom URL or model. You can also type a compatible chat completions URL. On-device dictation works without a transcription key.
support.a3: On-device dictation does not count. Each successful cloud listening session, each AI generation, and live translation during a session counts as 1 of 20 uses. After that, the unlock is a non-consumable one-time App Store purchase, not an auto-renewing subscription. The price is about US$9.99; Apple shows the local amount.
support.q4: I paid but it is still locked
support.a4: Tap Restore Purchases in Settings and confirm you are using the Apple ID that paid. Sandbox and production purchases do not mix. With Family Sharing on, members of the same family can use this unlock.
support.a5: Check that the key is complete, the provider still offers that model, and your network can reach the endpoint. For a LAN or local model, confirm the address is a service you run. Do not mail the full key.
support.q6: Does live translation use a trial?
support.a6: Yes. Live translation during a session shares the same 20 uses as cloud listening and AI replies. Translation goes to the provider you configured, not a quota we host.
support.q7: Recording behavior on iPhone and Mac
support.a7: On iPhone, leaving the app or locking the phone stops dictation. On Mac, use the window, menu bar or Option-Shift-D to start and stop capture; quitting stops capture. Obtain any required participant consent before recording or transcribing.
support.q8: I bought on iPhone. How do I open it on Mac?
support.a8: On Mac, sign in with the same Apple ID, open the app, and tap Restore Purchases in Settings. This is a non-consumable unlock, not a second charge per device.
terms.p1: Using Dictation Notes means you agree to these terms and Apple’s standard EULA. If they conflict, Apple’s rules win for purchase and refund questions. The seller is Shanghai Qishan Cultural Communication Co., Ltd.
terms.pLicense: We grant you a personal, non-transferable license to use the app on Apple devices you own or control. You may not reverse engineer the app, resell it, or use it for unlawful recording.
terms.pIap: On-device dictation stays free. Cloud transcription, optional live translation, and AI replies can be tried 20 times. The unlock is a non-consumable one-time App Store purchase, about US$9.99, not an auto-renewing subscription. The charge goes to your Apple ID. Family Sharing is available. Refunds are handled by Apple; a refund turns the unlock off. Restore with the same Apple ID.
terms.pByok: Transcription and AI requests go to third parties you configure. Their uptime, pricing, content rules, and outages are outside our control. You must follow those providers’ terms and keep your keys safe.
terms.pRecord: Record, transcribe, or summarize only where the law allows and any required consent exists. You are responsible for the resulting content.
terms.pDisclaimer: The app is provided as is. Replies, summaries, and forecasts can be wrong and are not professional advice. To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for indirect loss.

privacy.pApple: On Mac, free dictation prefers recognition on the device. iPhone may use on-device recognition or Apple speech services. If a Mac offline model is unavailable or fails, audio may also be sent to Apple speech services. Apple processes received audio under its privacy policy. The app explains possible Apple processing before listening and requests system speech recognition permission. Microphone and optional Mac system audio capture also require system permission.
privacy.pCloudData: Cloud providers may retain audio and other user content after a request, together with API account identifiers, request times and counts, token usage, error/trace logs and network information such as IP addresses. These may be linked to your provider account. They support authentication, transcription, AI features, security and service operations. Some providers also analyze usage or use submitted content to improve or train models under their own terms and account settings. The app does not send advertising identifiers or use these requests for advertising tracking.
privacy.pRetention: Retention, model training and international processing depend on the provider, endpoint, plan and account settings. We do not promise universal zero retention or no training. Check the linked current provider policies before sending sensitive content. Local deletion or revoking permission stops future sending but does not erase data already received by a provider; request deletion from that provider.

home.faq5q: Do Mac and iPhone automatically sync history?
home.faq5a: No. Session history, recordings and API settings remain on each device. Restoring the same App Store unlock on Mac and iPhone does not synchronize those files. Export or share the files you need yourself.
home.faq6a: No. Apple Speech prefers on-device recognition on Mac, but may send audio to Apple if an offline model is unavailable or fails. iPhone may also use Apple speech services. Offline availability depends on the language, model and system.
support.q9: How do I capture meeting audio on Mac?
support.a9: In Mac Settings, select system audio or mixed input. Allow screen and system audio recording in macOS Privacy & Security, then restart the app if macOS asks. Mixed input also needs microphone permission. The app uses ScreenCaptureKit for audio and does not save screen video. Use capture only with any required participant consent.
support.q10: How do I replay or export a recording?
support.a10: Open a saved Mac session and select its recording. Playback supports pause, a draggable playhead and 15-second skips. Export the text or notes as Markdown with Command-Shift-E, and export audio from the recording controls. Audio is available only if recording was enabled when the session was captured.
support.q11: How do I delete a Mac recording and undo it?
support.a11: Stop listening, then use the recording's trash button. The audio moves to the Mac Trash; its transcript and notes remain. Command-Option-Z restores the deletion during the same app run. Bulk history or recording cleanup is irreversible; exported copies must be deleted separately.
support.q12: How do I stop sending data to a provider?
support.a12: In Mac Settings, open Account and Privacy, then revoke data sharing permission. The app cancels ongoing cloud and AI requests. Changing the recipient requires new permission. Data already received by Apple or a provider is governed by that service; contact it to request deletion.
support.q13: Can I import records from the older Mac app?
support.a13: In Mac Settings, choose Import legacy records and select the old data folder. Keep a backup before importing. Text and available recordings are imported; a missing original audio file cannot be recovered from a transcript. Use Show data in Finder to locate the current app's data rather than assuming an old folder path.
support.q14: Can I use an AI model running on my Mac?
support.a14: Run a compatible chat completions service and set its endpoint in AI Settings, for example a loopback address on this Mac. Text sent to a model genuinely running on this Mac stays local to that service; a LAN or remote endpoint sends it off this Mac. Apple speech processing is independent. Local models still use the app's AI trial and unlock rules.
privacy.pCapture: Mac can capture a microphone, system audio or mixed input. System capture requires the macOS screen and system audio recording permission. ScreenCaptureKit supplies audio to the chosen recognition path and, when enabled, a local M4A or WAV recording. The app does not save screen video. Audio may include other participants or sounds from other apps.
privacy.pSync: The app does not automatically synchronize Mac and iPhone history or recordings. Purchase restoration restores the unlock only. Exporting, sharing or an operating-system backup may create copies at your chosen destination; that destination or backup service has its own privacy policy. Deleting the original does not delete these copies.
privacy.pSupport: If you email support, we receive your email address, message and any diagnostics or attachments you choose to send. We use them to answer and investigate your request. You can contact 281916057@qq.com to request deletion, subject to applicable retention requirements. Do not include API keys, private recordings or sensitive transcripts.
